title: Mochizuki Honami — The Kind Honor Student〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(This music... It must be the brass band.
How nostalgic.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was in the percussion section of the brass band in middle school too...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Whose side are you on, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I never want to remember that time again!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That's the same melody the brass band was playing... But who's humming?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Huh? It came from somewhere nearby, but where—)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Very good. Honami's reaction to my surprise is as fantastic as Tsukasa and the girl from class A.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait. But it's not really a gotcha if I only manage to make them surprised, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, why were you looking so upset just now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Was she trying to cheer me up because she saw me looking a little gloomy?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... I was in the brass band in middle school, so I had a trip down memory lane, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I hope my smile is convincing enough...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I have to go to the stage now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
S-Stage?
Oh, you mean in Phoenix Wonderland?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Honami!
Once our show's ready, you have to come watch, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then you'll definitely be able to smile from the heart!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
See you around, Honami!
Bye bye☆
